name: inspira-vortex
title: Vortex Background
blurb: Particles swirl in a vortex pattern with Simplex noise-driven motion.
description: Canvas-based particle system creating a mesmerizing vortex effect using Simplex noise for organic motion. Supports customizable particle count, speed, radius, and hue.
use_when: A dramatic, immersive full-page background that can wrap content with intricate particle animation.
avoid_when: Performance-sensitive contexts — complex noise calculation and RAF animation loop consume significant resources.
a11y: Wrapper component with content slot; focus and keyboard behaviour come from overlaid children. Animation has no prefers-reduced-motion guard.
